title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The resilience to future emergencies in Afghanistan programme implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to build the resilience of displaced and host communities affected by conflict and natural disasters by providing for their immediate survival needs and supporting them to gain the infrastructure and skills to be more resilient to future emergencies. The objectives of the programme is to provide emergency provisions and shelter, cash, and winterization support; to work with communities and provincial authorities in Takhar and Badakhshan provinces to manage and improve their emergency response in an effective and timely manner; and to support the disaster response capacity of local NGO partners. . Under CHC, Concern supported the budgeted capacity of two local/national NGO partners in Takhar and Badakhshan provinces for 2025. These partners effectively utilized the allocated capacity support, enabled them to contribute successfully to the implementation of the CHC project and strengthen overall programme delivery.
